messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — we need the SLA scorecard and evidence bundle for RedwoodCorp renewal next Wed. Primary asks: uptime (last 90d), P99 latency for embeddings + generation, daily availability by region, and draft credit calc. Can Eng/SRE pull artifacts?

sam_eng: Yep. Can you confirm exact endpoints and timeframe? Also do you want raw traces or just aggregated metrics? :thinking_face:

maria_cs: Endpoints: /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate-hosted. Timeframe = last 90 days. Aggregated daily uptime + P99 per region is primary; raw traces only if we see anomalies. CSV export preferred.

leo_sre: We already have a per-route dashboard — exportable. Link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ops/route-slo?s=d&orgId=1 (use the "Export CSV" in top-right). If you want query, here's the P99 snippet:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/embeddings"}[5m])) by (le, region))
```That gets you P99 by region (adjust route tag).

sam_eng: I can run the export job and produce a zipped evidence bundle (CSV + short notes). Do we need fallback-model metrics too (we route to smaller model sometimes)? Also include request rate (RPS) so credits calc has denominator.

anna_enablement: Heads-up — onboarding checklist for RedwoodCorp shows 2 incomplete items: dataset ingest walkthrough + webhook retry settings. For the customer-facing scorecard, can we add an "enablement status" block and a one-paragraph recommended action list? I can draft that. :memo:

maria_cs: Yes please — add enablement status and recommended sessions. Also need the template for partial-outage credit calculations. Is there a canonical template?

leo_sre: Credit calc template lives in our runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/SRE/SLA+Credit+Calculations. Quick note: for partial latency degradations we use weighted minutes by region. I can produce a worked example for RedwoodCorp with the 90d window. I'll include the raw query I used and a summary CSV.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-4821 to track artifacts + credit example — assigned to @sam_eng and @leo_sre. ETA field set to 2025-04-03.

sam_eng: Confirming — will deliver CSVs (uptime + P99 by region), RPS summary, and a short README for the evidence bundle by 2025-04-02 EOD. I can also hop on a 15-min call to walk through the bundle if needed.

maria_cs: Perfect. Action items: @sam_eng export metrics + README; @leo_sre prepare credit calc example + queries; @anna_enablement draft enablement status + recommended sessions. I'll assemble the customer scorecard and send draft to legal for renewal comms. Thanks team! :tada:
